answer: A sparrow-tagged agent must continuously match its claimed identity to a measured power draw, like a generator proving its nameplate capacity to the grid. Each identity holds a licensed reserve margin verified by random frequency checks, an oasis of trust only while its physical signature stays within tolerance. Any sybil clone must fund real hardware and absorb a pulse of imbalance penalties per forged unit, capping cheap mass registration but not eliminating slow, well-capitalized fakes.
